result.description: A fictional compact connectivity hub designed for tablets, ultrabooks, and handheld workstations. The PulseLink combines a USB-C upstream port with HDMI output, two USB-A ports, a microSD slot, and pass-through charging in a slim anodized enclosure. It is intended for mobile productivity rather than storage, with emphasis on display expansion and peripheral access. The unit is marketed as a lightweight desk-and-travel accessory with plug-and-play operation on common desktop and notebook operating systems.
result.title: Asterion PulseLink USB-C Travel Hub
result.title_description: USB-C travel hub with HDMI, USB-A, microSD, and pass-through charging
